entities.name: Collapse of Serra's Realm
entities.description: Event of the last moments of Serra's Realm, destroyed after Urza's return.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: Plane corrupted by Phyrexia and ruled by Radiant; it collapsed.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who returned to save Serra's Realm and staged an exodus.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: New ruler of Serra's Realm who tore the Mightstone and Weakstone from Urza.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane whose grasp had corrupted Serra's Realm.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship used to carry Serran refugees; later charged with the plane's energies.

entities.name: Gherridarigaaz
entities.description: Shivan Dragon killed saving Urza's life.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: Dragon who rode through the skies during the battle.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Stone in Urza's skull, torn out by Radiant.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Stone in Urza's skull, torn out by Radiant.

entities.name: Serra's Sanctum
entities.description: Place where Radiant tried to reunite the two stones.

events.summary: Urza returned to Serra's Realm and discovered the extent of its corruption.
events.quote: Urza returned to Serra's Realm in hopes of saving it from Phyrexia 's grasp, but instead discovered the extent of the plane's corruption.

events.summary: Gherridarigaaz was killed saving Urza from Radiant's attack.
events.quote: The Shivan Dragon Gherridarigaaz was killed saving Urza's life from Radiant' magical attack

events.summary: Radiant tore the Mightstone and Weakstone from Urza's skull.
events.quote: Radiant confronted Urza directly and tore out the Mightstone and Weakstone from his skull.

events.summary: Radiant tried to reunite the stones, destroying Serra's palace and dying.
events.quote: This caused a blast of power that destroyed Serra's palace.

events.summary: Urza charged the Weatherlight's powerstone core with the plane's energies as it collapsed.
events.quote: With the plane collapsing around them, Urza charged the ship's powerstone core with the magical energies from the plane

relations.quote: Radiant attempted to prevent this and attacked the skyship with her angels .
